title: Authenticated desktop menu bootstrap

crossYearFixture.description: 메뉴 목록은 JWT userId와 코드의 MENU_ITEMS만 사용한다. OrderYear/OrderWeek를 포함한 ERP 업무키나 MSSQL 테이블을 읽거나 쓰지 않으며 연도가 달라도 원장 부작용이 없다.

dnspyEvidence.source: 데스크톱 메뉴 부트스트랩은 nenova.exe 업무 기능이 아닌 웹 메뉴 조회다. JWT 인증과 MENU_ITEMS 필터만 수행하며 ERP 원장을 조회·수정하지 않는다.
methods: NenovaWeb withAuth JWT userId verification and Layout MENU_ITEMS filtering
tables: UserInfo (login source only; no bootstrap query)

authentication: Existing nenovaToken cookie or Bearer JWT through withAuth; userId comes only from the verified token

response.webVersion: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_VERSION, falling back to the deployed Next BUILD_ID

rules: Preserve MENU_ITEMS group and item order; omit groups with no visible items.
A userIds gate passes only if userIds.includes(verified userId) exactly, including case.
Never expose userIds or other menu metadata in the response.
Return private no-store responses and vary by Cookie and Authorization, including errors.
The route reads no database table and writes no ERP ledger.
PC download links on login and the standard topbar point to a versioned public release asset. No authentication values or ERP data are sent; no ERP API is invoked.

NenovaDesktop user agent enables presentation-only compact chrome. Tools reveal restores web navigation, language/logout and contextual back without replacing WebContents or resetting input. Print and business controls are preserved.

nativeUpdate.feed: Fixed HTTPS GitHub repository latest/download; local shell IPC only
nativeUpdate.policy: Explicit check/download/restart, no update on ordinary quit; downgrade disabled; metadata allowlist and SHA512 integrity; unsigned installer has no publisher identity guarantee
nativeUpdate.preserve: No ERP writes or request replay; persist encrypted window metadata successfully before approved restart
nativeUpdate.crossYear: Restored 2025/2026 routes remain separate through existing safeSnapshot and separate-process restore fixture

menuFavorites: Web and PC expose independent per-menu star controls; originals remain visible. PC requires verified current actor and exact current menu href (or built-in /dashboard), stores encrypted local metadata. Web reuses owner-scoped dashboard-menu favorites API. No ERP writes or year/week mutation.
desktopExit: Last-window native close defers confirmed app.quit to the next event-loop turn; cancel preserves windows and tabs; separate Electron child must truly exit without app.exit on success. Existing encrypted metadata and ERP ledgers are preserved.
compactPresentation: PC-only screen CSS hides explicitly marked duplicate title text; tools reveal restores it. Explicit filter-bar controls use 30px height/13px font while table and role=grid descendants retain geometry. Standard outer padding is 6px 8px. Native home uses available width and wraps menu labels. Print, standard web presentation, business actions, ERP reads/writes, virtual row sizing, statuses and year/week identity are preserved.
incomingDatePresentation: InputDate table label shows the valid original YYYY-MM-DD prefix without timezone conversion; null/empty shows an em dash and invalid values retain the raw text. Tooltip retains raw value. API, filter inputs, raw sorting, export values and ERP ledger are unchanged. Fixtures preserve 2025/2026 boundary dates and timezone-offset source dates.
